# social-service-ea per-operation parity backlog

Baseline: `decentraland/social-service-ea@b6b2cefefdf727b2ed47ddb887e77d226a41eea6`. The machine source is [parity.json](parity.json).

The source inventory contains **123 operations**: 5 api_auxiliary, 72 api_http, 6 json_stream, 6 rpc_stream, 27 rpc_unary, 5 uws_http, 2 websocket.

reviewed means the stated source/behaviour scope was compared; it never means exhaustive equivalence. known_gap names a remaining observed difference. not_reviewed requires an explicit comparison, even if a matching route or local test exists.

Source hashes include the pinned service registrations, handlers, stream definitions, lockfile and the installed framework code that supplies health, CORS, metrics and fallback handling. `tooling/social-service-parity.py --upstream <checkout>` re-derives that inventory; the default check validates its complete backlog, local evidence references and the 33-method protocol set without an external checkout.

Executed upstream handler cases live in [source-cases.json](source-cases.json); their Protobuf bytes are replayed by `rpc_wire_answers_match_executed_upstream_source_cases`. Those cases use injected dependencies and do not prove deployed HTTP, Redis, SNS, PostgreSQL or live-client equivalence.

## Shared gaps and replacement requirements

These requirements remain open even when an operation's focused review passes. A local implementation or a matching fixture does not establish a completed cutover.

| Requirement | Status | Evidence and remaining work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `historical-profile-identity` | known_gap | Historical pre-identity-validation profiles with avatar.userId different from the active pointer are omitted locally; upstream registry reduction can preserve their profile identity. Preserve this as an observed resolver difference until source golden coverage and an explicit implementation decision resolve it. |
| `external-notification-consumers` | known_gap | Optional SNS publishing exists for referral events. Friendship and community notification producers still require source-compatible SNS wiring; writing a local inbox does not preserve existing external subscribers. Deployed subscriptions, duplicate delivery and cutover remain unverified. |
| `cross-replica-social-events` | unverified | Mutation fanout now uses the existing core NATS link; two real broker connections, scoped delivery and large public snapshots pass locally. Deployed replica/consumer behavior and burst/outage equivalence remain unverified; the256-entry outbound queue can drop before source per-subscription limits. |
| `community-started-audience-lifetime` | unverified | Audience scope/generation/24-hour refreshed expiry now persist in shared SQL. Restart, expiry, generation-CAS and retained immutable event snapshots pass local tests. Existing room state, external media continuity and deployed cutover remain unverified. |
| `referral-lifecycle` | known_gap | Attribution/IP rejection, signup, UTC login days, guarded grants, artwork and email now have source-paired/local regressions and optional real SQS/SNS SDK transport. Source-specific database error envelopes and Slack alert side effects remain gaps; stateful cutover is unverified. |
| `community-ranking-and-configured-moderation` | known_gap | Dynamic moderators and ranking producers are implemented with focused source/local regressions. Enabled AI compliance remains under implementation. Existing lifetime counter baselines and watermarks are not imported, so historical ranking equality remains unverified. |
| `shared-fixed-window-friendship-limit` | unverified | The implemented SQL limiter now matches eight executed source/Redis scenarios plus concurrent replica, fixed-expiry and configuration regressions. Existing Redis counter state has not been imported or drained during a nonempty cutover; a fresh SQL counter resets the active window. |
| `cutover-with-existing-state` | unverified | No nonempty migration snapshot, deployed provider/edge configuration, active LiveKit call continuity, running-client comparison or rollback rehearsal has been supplied or executed. These are replacement acceptance requirements, separate from local contract tests. |
| `referral-external-cutover` | unverified | Configured official SQS/SNS transports preserve legacy raw events and attributes locally; deployed queue policies,topic subscriptions and real credential access have not been exercised. The additive upgrade preserves populated candidate IDs in synthetic tests; import of existing upstream progress/login-days/reward/email state and live cutover remain outstanding. Ranking event dispatch and other SNS producer wiring are subsequent packages. |
| `api-body-size-boundary` | known_gap | The pinned HTTP server applies HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES and rejects oversized declared bodies with413 before authentication; the current gateway still uses handler-level hardcoded limits. Declared/chunked body overflow, configured limits, response/CORS and connection-close behavior need a full boundary comparison and fix. |
